slides.headline: 1) TRACK EVERY PLANE IN THE SKY RIGHT NOW
slides.body:
OVER 100,000 FLIGHTS CROSS THE WORLD'S SKIES EVERY DAY. FLIGHTRADAR24 TRACKS ALL OF THEM.

Point your phone at any plane overhead and it names the flight instantly.

slides.headline: 2) WATCH STORMS BUILD ANYWHERE ON EARTH
slides.body:
PROFESSIONAL WEATHER DATA THIS DETAILED COSTS THOUSANDS A YEAR. WINDY GIVES IT FREE.

Zoom into any ocean and watch wind streams spiral into hurricanes in real time.

slides.headline: THE INTERNET LIVES UNDERWATER
slides.body: OVER 400 CABLES ON THE OCEAN FLOOR CARRY 95% OF ALL INTERNET TRAFFIC. A cable off Virginia reaches London in roughly 70 milliseconds.

slides.headline: 4) SEE HOW BIG COUNTRIES REALLY ARE
slides.body: EVERY WORLD MAP YOU HAVE EVER SEEN DISTORTED THE SIZE OF EVERY COUNTRY. Drag Greenland to the equator and Africa is 14 times larger. Russia fits inside Africa with room to spare.

slides.headline: 5) FLY THROUGH THE SOLAR SYSTEM IN 3D
slides.body: NASA BUILT A FREE REAL-TIME SIMULATOR OF EVERY PLANET, MOON, AND SPACECRAFT. Rewind to watch Voyager 1 launch in 1977. Today it sits over 23 billion km from Earth, still transmitting.

slides.headline: 6) READ ANY RESEARCH PAPER FOR FREE
slides.body: THE PAPER BEHIND CHATGPT WAS PUBLISHED FREE AT ARXIV IN 2017. MOST PEOPLE STILL DON'T KNOW THE SITE EXISTS. Over 2 million papers across AI, physics, and biology. No account. No paywall.

caption:
Swipe through all 6 and save the list. The internet most people use every day is a fraction of what's actually out there. 🌍

One real-time plane tracker that names any flight overhead, one animated storm map showing wind across the whole planet, a map of all 400-plus underwater cables that carry the internet, a tool revealing how distorted every world map is, a free 3D solar system simulator from NASA, and a library of over 2 million research papers with no paywall.

These six sites share one truth: the world is fully documented, live, and free to explore. The infrastructure, the forces shaping it, the knowledge explaining it, all public. Most people never look. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
